## Description
Please include a summary of the change and which issue or agent role it addresses.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (addition to the pipeline or rules)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Script / Automation update

## Checklist
- [ ] My code/markdown follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have run the test suite (`python -m pytest tests/ -q`)
- [ ] I have run `python scripts/sync_skills.py --check` (after touching `SKILL.md` / `skills/`)
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation in `README.md` and bumped version files (`VERSION`, `distribution.yaml`, `SKILL.md`) if needed
